note: Hand-maintained knowledge about every asset pack, the decisions already made about it, so they are never re-asked (CLAUDE.md 'Asset integration policy'). tools/assets/scan_packs.py reads this, measures every pack (files, sizes, frame grids, licence files, what was imported via game/assets/PROVENANCE.json) and writes docs/assets/ASSET_REGISTRY.md and data/asset_registry.json. Licence wording comes from the pack's own files or the page the owner supplied (ASSET_MANIFEST.md notes); 'storage' public = in the public repository, private = private-assets/ (git-ignored; only imported game files are committed). status: integrated (used in play), partial (some content used, more planned), planned (a task exists), reference (not for the game: tools, sources, docs), unused (reviewed; why in 'decision').

packs.name: Cozy RPG SFX (ambience 1 and 2, and the 48 effects)
packs.creator: Spaceyyy (Bramble & Byte), aquumgifts.itch.io
packs.permissions: Use in personal and commercial games and apps, no royalties; modify allowed; the sounds themselves may not be resold or redistributed as assets (so private-assets; only the imported Ogg files are committed). Credit appreciated: 'Cozy RPG SFX by Bramble & Byte' (the owner's credit: by Spaceyyy).
packs.used_for: SFX-18, through GameAudio.play_sfx on the SFX bus. Ambience loops (game/assets/sfx): forest (the woods: the countryside by day), cave_wind (the natural cave, level -2), dungeon (drips: the mine gallery and the shafts). Effects wired: sword_swing_1/2 (the player's swing), sword_hit_1/2 and critical_hit (a landed blow), enemy_hit (a blow on game), enemy_defeat (a foe or game falls to the player), player_hurt (a point of health lost), fireball (the cast), coin (a purchase or sale), chest_open (a chest window opens), equip_weapon / equip_armor (wielding or wearing), potion_drink (a healing food or medicine used), door_wood (the player steps through a doorway), book_page (a wiki page opens), jingle_quest_accepted / jingle_quest_complete, jingle_level_up (a skill level), jingle_inn_rest (the player rests), secret_found (a trial pit strikes ore), save_crystal (a manual save).
packs.opportunities: Unwired for want of a matching event in the game: campfire (ambience; the game has no cheap 'beside a lit fire' test: a fire or the tavern hearth could play it by distance), spell-cast, ice-spell, lightning, heal, buff, debuff, teleport, magic-shield, mana-restore, potion-bubble (the game has one spell, the fireball, and no other magic), arrow-hit and bow-shot (no bow), shield-block (no shield), punch (no unarmed attack sound distinct from the swing), slime-squish (no slimes), key-pickup, gem (no event distinct from the pack's pickups), scroll-open, door-iron (no iron doors), step-stone-1/2 (replaced by Minifantasy footsteps), torch-light, lever, trap-spikes (no such objects), jingle-victory and jingle-defeat (a fight's end and the death panel could use them), the quest jingles for contracts.

packs.used_for: SFX-18: soft footsteps by the ground (step_grass, step_dirt on roads, step_stone underground and indoors; about -16 dB, pitch +/-5%, spaced by distance walked), bush_rustling (picking a plant or field harvest), tree_rustling (a tree falls near the player), fruit_drop (picking fruit), hit_on_wood (each chop), hit_on_brick (a mining or tunnelling stroke).
